12 November 2002

## Circular to Registered Investment Advisers on

## Cold Calling

The Securities and Futures Commission has recently received a number of complaints against registered investment advisers for cold calling to sell funds and financial advisory or planning services.

The Commission wishes to take this opportunity to remind registered investment advisers of the  provisions  of  section  74  of  the  Securities  Ordinance  ('SO').    Section  74(1)  of  the  SO states as follows:

'Subject to subsections (2) 1 and (3) 2 , a person shall not, whether on his own behalf or otherwise and whether by appointment or otherwise, call 3 from place to place -

- (a) making or offering to make with any person -
- (i)  an agreement for or with a view to having that other person purchase specific securities 4 ; or
- (ii) an agreement the purpose or pretended purpose of which is to secure a profit  to  that  other  person  from  the  yield  of  specific  securities  or  by reference to fluctuations in the value of specific securities; or
- (b) inducing  or  attempting  to  induce  any  other  person  to  enter  into  an agreement of the type referred to in paragraph (a)(i) or (ii),

whether or not in calling from place to place he does any other act or thing.'

Registered investment advisers are reminded to ensure that they comply with section 74(1) of the SO.  Any person who contravenes this subsection is guilty of an offence and liable on conviction to a fine of up to $50,000 and imprisonment for up to 2 years.

## Licensing Department Securities and Futures Commission

1 Subsection (2) contains carve-outs from the prohibition in subsection (1) e.g. in relation to calls made to a banker,  solicitor,  professional  accountant,  registered  or  exempt  dealer,  registered  or  exempt  investment adviser, registered dealer's representative or registered investment representative.

2 Subsection (3) enables the Commission to make rules exempting certain securities or classes of securities from the prohibition in subsection (1). No such rules have been made to date.

3 Under section 74(6) of the SO, 'to call' includes to visit in person and to communicate in telephone.

4 The definition of 'securities' in section 2(1) of the SO includes 'funds'.
